root_cause: In trajectory_collect_engine.py:574, when environment_input (self.env.task) has 'policy_version', it unconditionally overrides trajectory_input (self.agent.trajectory.task). In FrozenLake, self.env.task only contains {'policy_version': 0, ...} and lacks 'prompts', whereas the agent's trajectory.task holds the actual {'prompts': [...]}. The override causes original_input to lack 'prompts', triggering ValueError: policy-seeded trajectory original_input is missing required key 'prompts' at line 596.
remediation: In trajectory_collect_engine.py:574, only prefer environment_input if trajectory_input is None (pre-observation termination fallback) or if environment_input contains 'prompts'; otherwise preserve or merge trajectory_input so that 'prompts' is retained across FrozenLake and all environments.
